reason: The text explicitly depicts YHWH intervening on behalf of Israel as a national group against Egypt. Key evidence includes: (1) The Israelites crying out to YHWH as their God; (2) Moses assuring Israel that 'YHWH will fight for you' (יְהוָ֖ה יִלָּחֵ֣ם לָכֶ֑ם); (3) YHWH actively fighting for Israel in Egypt (יְהוָ֔ה נִלְחָ֥ם לָהֶ֖ם בְּמִצְרָֽיִם); (4) Divine protection through the pillar of cloud positioned between the Egyptian and Israelite camps; (5) YHWH saving Israel as a nation from Egypt's hand (וַיּ֨וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֜ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֛וּא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל); (6) Israel's national response of fear and belief in YHWH. The passage presents YHWH as the God specifically committed to the national interests and survival of Israel, actively intervening in inter-national conflict on their behalf.
